content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who meet the eligibility criteria can apply online for the IIT Hyderabad Various Posts Recruitment 2026. Applications must be submitted online on or before 17-09-2026. To apply directly, use the Apply Online link provided in the Important Links section. Alternatively, candidates may visit the official website of IIT Hyderabad to complete the application. Fill out the application form carefully with correct personal, educational, and contact details. Upload required documents such as photograph, signature, and certificates in the prescribed format. Pay the application fee online, if applicable. Review all details carefully before submitting the form. Take a printout or save a copy of the submitted application for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the IIT Hyderabad Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date for submission of online applications is 17 September 2026. Candidates are advised to apply well in advance to avoid any last-minute technical issues.

faq.question: Q2. What are the posts available in the IIT Hyderabad Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The available posts are Duty Medical Officer and Staff Nurse. There are 2 vacancies for Duty Medical Officer and 3 vacancies for Staff Nurse.

faq.question: Q3. What is the educational qualification required for the Duty Medical Officer post?
faq.answer: For the Duty Medical Officer post, candidates must possess an MBBS degree with internship and valid Medical Council registration. One year of post-qualification experience is preferred.

faq.question: Q4. What is the educational qualification required for the Staff Nurse post?
faq.answer: For the Staff Nurse post, candidates need to have completed Intermediate/10+2 or equivalent with a 3-year General Nursing and Midwifery or B.Sc Nursing degree. Three years of post-qualification experience in a recognized hospital is required.

faq.question: Q5. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) in the official notification.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary offered for these positions?
faq.answer: The salary offered is Rs. 60,000/- per month for Duty Medical Officer and Rs. 35,000/- per month for Staff Nurse.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for IIT Hyderabad Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The selection process will involve a Written Test, Skill Test, and Interview.

faq.question: Q8. How can I apply for the IIT Hyderabad Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Candidates need to apply online through the official website of IIT Hyderabad on or before the last date of application.

faq.question: Q9. What is the total number of vacancies?
faq.answer: There are a total of 5 vacancies for the posts of Duty Medical Officer and Staff Nurse.

faq.question: Q10. Where is IIT Hyderabad located?
faq.answer: Indian Institute of Technology Hyderabad is located in Sangareddy, Telangana.
